name: 08 - Seating Charts - STM products refresh - HELPER

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$input.all().map(i=>i.json);if(rows.length!==1||!rows[0].enabled||rows[0].schedule_enabled||rows[0].config.productReservations?.enabled!==true)throw Error('Product schedule or mapping not authorized');const target=$('Require registered STM class').first().json;const mapping=rows[0].config.productReservations.templates[String(target.templateSheetId??target.sheetId)];if(!Array.isArray(mapping)||mapping.length!==3)throw Error('Unmapped product template');return [{json:{...target,productMapping:mapping}}];

parameters.jsCode: const t=$('Claim private product refresh').first().json.target,f=$input.first().json;if(f.id!==t.spreadsheetId||f.id===t.masterSpreadsheetId||f.mimeType!=='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'||f.capabilities?.canEdit!==true||!f.owners?.some(o=>o.emailAddress===t.googleAccountEmail))throw Error('Wrong product chart ownership');return [{json:{verified:true}}];
